Claims Runbook

How the nightly claims batch is routed. Owned by the claims platform team; page reviewed each quarter.

Routing rule

Claims above the manual-review threshold never route automatically:

def route(claim):
    if claim["amount"] > 5000:
        return "manual"
    if claim["provider"] not in NETWORK:
        return "manual"
    return "auto"

If the batch fails

  1. Check claims-batch in the job console

  2. Re-run with --resume; it is idempotent per claim id

  3. If two re-runs fail, page the on-call engineer

The batch writes its own audit trail; do not edit rows by hand.
